The current planned launch date of the Aurora NP-7 is **2027-03-18** [S1][S2][S3][S4].

It was moved from 2027-03-04 after the 2027-01-12 launch sync, because lens yield was 71%, below the 85% threshold [S3][S4][S5].

Lens yield reported for the 2027-01-12 decision was **71 percent**. The release threshold was **85 percent** [S1][S2][S3].

- On 2027-01-12, Mingyuan Gu stated lens yield was 71 percent and launch moved to 2027-03-18 [S2].
- The 2027-02-20 readiness report says the delay was approved that day because yield was 71 percent against the threshold [S1].
- The NP-7 test plan lists first-batch yield at 71 percent and the release threshold at 85 percent [S3].

**Daniel Ortiz** (丹尼尔·奥尔蒂斯) is the Hardware Lead [S1][S2].

He is on the Engineering team; email daniel.ortiz@northport-optics.example [S1]. He is also listed as owner of the NP7 product spec [S2].

The total value of the Hengding lens supply contract is CNY 2,480,000 (人民币二百四十八万元) [S1].

Contract no. NPO-2027-014, signed 2027-01-20 between Northport Optics and Hengding Optoelectronics (恒鼎光电) for optical lenses for the 极光 NP-7 smart glasses [S1]. A 30 percent deposit of CNY 744,000 is due within 7 days of signing [S1].
The retail price of the Aurora NP-7 is CNY 3,999 [S1].
The product spec states a battery life of **9 hours** [S1].
The Aurora NP-7 weighs **38 g** [S1][S2][S3].
Ziqian Ke is on the Quality team [S1]. The roster lists the role as QA Engineer (质量工程师) [S1].

**顾明远 (Mingyuan Gu), VP Product, decided the delay at the 2027-01-12 项目同步会 (launch sync). It was formalised in the signed memo he issued the next day.**

- At that meeting he moved the 极光 NP-7 launch from 2027-03-04 to 2027-03-18 because lens yield was 71%, below the 85% threshold [S1]. The minutes were recorded by 白若冰 [S2].
- The signed memo dated 2027-01-13 (发件人/签名：顾明远) records the same change and states the decision was made at the 2027-01-12 sync [S3]. Issuing that memo was his action item, due 2027-01-13 [S4].
